data.name: lblPrepIntro.Text
data.value: Checks the workstation (clock, disk, proxy, VPN, hosts file), then clears the cache, cookies, storage and history of the evidence browser and verifies the result. A system proxy or a VPN must be justified in the official record.

data.name: lblNetIntro.Text
data.value: Records, before any evidence is gathered: local IP configuration (ipconfig data), active DNS servers, the public IP address (confirmed by several independent services), the NTP reference time and the holder of the public address.

data.name: lblSealIntro.Text
data.value: Sealing takes the official NTP time, re-hashes every file and compares it with the fingerprint taken when it was created, closes the audit log, writes the manifest, the HTML report and the receipt, then verifies the package. It cannot be undone: write the manifest SHA-256 shown below in the official record.
